name: Dashboard and complete experience

initiation_authorization.evidence: Human authorized Phase 08 planning on 2026-08-14 America/Sao_Paulo.

plan_approval.evidence: After receiving the Phase 08 plan, human explicitly authorized implementation. This authorizes the planned dashboard/complete-experience implementation only and does not authorize PR, merge, deploy, real providers, sandbox, credentials, public callbacks, Phase 09 or release.

expected_features: Organization-scoped operational dashboard composed only from canonical Customers, Orders, Fulfillment, Payments, Messaging and Integrations data.
Read-only attention queues for orders, payments, fulfillment, messaging and integrations with explicit links back to canonical domain screens.
Consolidated order workspace showing customer, payment, fulfillment and messaging context without duplicating domain state.
Unified navigation, responsive empty states and operational filters suitable for desktop and mobile use.
Explicit roadmap branch identifiers are authoritative; governance no longer derives Git branch names from human-readable phase titles.
deferred_features: inbound WhatsApp sales conversation domain or omnichannel inbox
new CRM, inventory, ERP, fiscal, tax, accounting or marketing lifecycle
real providers, credentials, sandbox calls and public callbacks
infrastructure/homologation, deploy and cutover in Phases 09-10

states.rule: Dashboard creates no canonical business lifecycle. Every indicator and queue is derived from existing Organization-scoped domain state.

snapshots: No new persistent dashboard snapshot is planned.
Views expose only the minimum operational fields necessary and must not surface raw payloads, credentials, secrets, full private contact snapshots or arbitrary integration metadata.
idempotency: Dashboard endpoints are read-only GET operations and do not introduce command idempotency keys.
Any action link hands control to the owning domain, which retains its existing idempotency and authorization rules.
money_rules: Dashboard never computes or mutates canonical money.
Displayed payment/order amounts come from canonical Order or PaymentIntent fields and remain BRL domain values.
authorization: Organization derives from active Membership and session, never from an arbitrary request Organization id.
Any active Organization member may view the operational dashboard; actions remain governed by the owning domain policies.
Selectors receive an Organization object and apply Organization filters at every domain boundary.
Cross-Organization visibility requires direct negative tests.

required: dashboard KPI and attention-queue correctness for canonical domain states
consolidated order workspace cannot cross Organization boundaries
read-only GET behavior and no dashboard persistence model
query-count/N+1 regression for bounded dashboard lists
governance branch-id validation and full regression suite
tests.sandbox_contract_validation: Not applicable; external validation remains separately authorized.

coverage.domain_expectation: Dashboard selectors, isolation, queue classification, workspace composition and authorization require direct tests.

ci: migration consistency and historical rollback gates
documentation: dashboard read-model boundaries and dependency direction
acceptance_criteria: Plan is explicitly approved before implementation.
Implementation remains based on actual_base_sha 005e11c1c7c14440562806fe0301f3a0ad4763b5 and approved Phase 07 product head cba7d6cbebbcf672bb313472d5e1d7e431e48df5.
Dashboard introduces no canonical business-state model or migration.
All dashboard reads are scoped by active Organization Membership and cross-Organization tests pass.
Operational counts and queues derive from canonical domain states without rewriting their business rules.
Order workspace composes existing customer/payment/fulfillment/messaging context without creating a parallel lifecycle.
No external network call, provider activation, credential, public callback or deploy occurs.
Total coverage remains at least 85% and CI is green on the material candidate.
Independent Review and QA/Security GO are required before final human approval.
PR, merge, release, deploy and Phase 09 require separate explicit human authorization.

handoff_format.base_sha_semantics: Exact origin/main SHA resolved before branch creation.

allowed_scope: Greenfield Organization-scoped dashboard/read-composition layer using approved Vidalys Flow domains only.
Operational KPIs, attention queues, consolidated order workspace, navigation, filters, responsive templates, selectors, policies and tests.
Narrow governance correction so explicit roadmap/manifest branch identifiers are authoritative.
forbidden_scope: Any new business lifecycle that belongs to Orders, Fulfillment, Payments, Messaging or Integrations.
Inbound WhatsApp conversation/inbox domain hidden inside Dashboard.
Any real provider, sandbox, credential, public callback, production effect, deploy or Coolify action.
ERP, fiscal, accounting, tax, inventory, marketing, infrastructure, homologation or cutover.
Any Flowlog runtime/data/code/infrastructure reuse or linkage.
PR, merge, release or Phase 09 without separate explicit human authorization.
